numeric_model.method: Exact calibrated margin/total distribution per game (no sampling), centered on the BKR line; the blended projection enters as a margin/total adjustment vs the market.
numeric_model.blend: 60% current BKR market-implied score; 25% FTN standardized season-to-date team attack/defense/pacing context; 15% nflverse SRS margin; capped secondary-absence context with the slate-mean removed (zero-sum).
numeric_model.calibration_status: Score-error shape (SDs, key numbers 3/7, pushes) calibrated to pinned 2018-2025 market residuals. The 60/25/15 blend, the FTN z-score scale (1.55) and SRS inputs are NOT backtested; no edge is claimed.

explicit_staleness: DVOA snapshot lane retired 2026-10-10; FTN is the current-season efficiency source
